display.purpose: The Willkommen bei Hogwarts hero over the castle band only.

banner.purpose: Board name inside the tincture banner.

title.purpose: Section titles, edition and Staff ribbons, way-onward names, brand wordmark.

numeral.purpose: Open count on each pennant; Regeln counters at 2.5rem.

body.purpose: All running text; tabular numerals site-wide.

label.purpose: Uppercase data term bound to a value; never above a heading.

mono.purpose: Server address, coordinates, player names: anything copied or typed into the game.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: The gules error notice. Day: 0 2px 6px rgb(40 30 20 / 0.16).

shadows.name: hanging-cloth
shadows.purpose: Filter on each pennant, following its swallowtail.

shadows.name: gilt-rail
shadows.purpose: The rod the pennants hang from.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every transition and entrance; exponential settle.

motion.name: ease-in
motion.purpose: Exits only: the outgoing page in a view switch (200ms).

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: The sliding tab/nav indicator only; a slight overshoot as it lands.

motion.name: dur-1
motion.purpose: Colour and border state changes, button press, focus-ring settle.

motion.name: dur-2
motion.purpose: Row entrance, toast in and out, shield fill, charge draw and seal stamp, vote press, rolling digits, sun/moon turn, hover hairlines.

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: Pennant drop, banner unfurl, sliding indicator, page switch, theme cloth-lower, copy ring settle.

motion.name: drop
motion.purpose: Pennant drop distance (half, sideways, on mobile).

motion.name: page-shift
motion.purpose: View-transition slide distance in the direction of travel.

motion.name: cloth-swing
motion.purpose: Pennant swings on its rod after the drop; desktop only.

motion.name: reveal-stagger
motion.purpose: Scroll reveal stagger between sibling rows, cloths and pennants.

motion.name: undo-window
motion.purpose: Undo toast countdown before the DELETE is sent; pauses on hover and focus.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration is zeroed and spatial keyframes are gated off; colour and state still change.

components.name: Status Pip
components.description: Escutcheon pip plus a word: ash while loading, beacon green online, ember red offline. The pip strikes once when the server comes online; offline is an outlined shield.
components.css: :host, .ds-root { --or:#d4a23c; --or-hi:#e7bc5e; --on-or:#1a1206; --gules:#b0362c; --purpure:#6c3a86; --vert:#276b44; --azure:#2d5ba6; --sable-field:#2a2430; --on-tincture:#fff8ea; --ground:#141116; --ground-raised:#1d1920; --ground-sunk:#0f0d11; --ink:#ece6da; --ink-dim:#b4ac9f; --link:var(--or); --rule:rgb(236 230 218 / 0.14); --rule-strong:rgb(236 230 218 / 0.28); --state-on:#4cc283; --state-off:#e2604f; --state-wait:#8a8379; --radius:2px; --hit:44px; --ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); --dur-1:160ms; --dur-2:320ms; --dur-3:560ms; --drop:12px; --font-display:"IM Fell English SC","Iowan Old Style",Georgia,serif; --font-ui:"Atkinson Hyperlegible",system-ui,sans-serif; --font-mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace; } .ds-root { background:var(--ground); padding:16px; color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--font-ui); } .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin:0; color:var(--ink-dim); font-size:0.875rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-status b { color:var(--ink); } .ds-pip { width:10px; height:12px; background:var(--state-wait); clip-path:polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 55%, 50% 100%, 0 55%); } [data-state="online"] .ds-pip { background:var(--state-on); } [data-state="offline"] .ds-pip { background:var(--state-off); } [data-state="offline"] .ds-pip { background:transparent; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--state-off); } @keyframes ds-pip-strike { 0% { scale:0.4; opacity:0; } 45% { scale:1.35; opacity:1; } 100% { scale:1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { [data-state="online"] .ds-pip { animation:ds-pip-strike 640ms var(--ease-out) both; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is a heraldic roll of arms for a building crew. Each of the five boards flies its own tincture, and heraldry's rule of tincture (metal on colour, never colour on colour) is the whole contrast system. The ground is cloth, not a dashboard panel: a near-black sable at night and warm vellum by day, both carrying a faint 4px warp-and-weft weave. Text is argent, actions are or (gold), and a board's colour shows up only as a field (pennant, banner, ribbon) or as a small escutcheon shield marking which board something belongs to.

The layout is dense and plain, because people use it mid-session next to a running game. Structure comes from 1px hairlines on a 4px grid, not from cards or shadows. The ceremony is kept to a few devices: the gilt rail of hanging pennants on Start, the swallowtail banner that unfurls over each board, the Fell display face, and the shield shape repeated at every scale from the 10px status pip to the 40px empty-state mark. Everything else is quiet UI in Atkinson Hyperlegible.

Both themes are first-class. Night is the default (no JS means night). Day keeps the same tinctures and deepens the gold so fills and focus rings still hold 3:1 on vellum.
keyCharacteristics: Five fixed board tinctures (gules, purpure, vert, azure, sable). They look the same in both themes and always carry argent text.
Or (gold) marks action: the primary button, links, focus rings, the active nav underline, the checked shield.
Every divider is one 1px hairline. Corners are cut to 2px.
Escutcheon and swallowtail silhouettes made with clip-path. No other ornament.
Woven ground texture, flat surfaces, and shadows only where something hangs or floats.
One signature motion: the pennant drop (12px, exponential ease-out).

rules.name: The Rule of Tincture
rules.body: Anything laid on a tincture field (pennant, banner, ribbon, error notice) is argent ({colors.on-tincture}) or or. Tinctures are never used as text colour, and one tincture never sits on another.

rules.name: The Or Is Action Rule
rules.body: Gold means "you can press this" or "this has focus". The only static uses are the brand shield and the Regeln rule numerals. Don't use or as decoration on a surface you can't act on.

rules.name: The One Board, One Tincture Rule
rules.body: A board's colour reaches the UI only through `--tincture` bound by `data-tincture`. A new board gets a new tincture key. It never borrows a hex.

rules.name: The Fell Is for Names Rule
rules.body: IM Fell English SC sets names and numbers: titles, board names, ribbons, counts. It never sets running text, buttons, form labels, or metadata.

rules.name: The Copyable Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything a player copies or types into the game (the IP, coordinates, player names) is set in JetBrains Mono. Nothing else is.

rules.name: The Nothing Floats Without Reason Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a shadow only if it hangs (pennant, rail) or floats over content (toast, error notice). Rows, forms, tabs, and panels stay flat on the cloth.

dos: Do read a board's colour from `--tincture` through `data-tincture`. Give a new board its own tincture key.
Do set every word on a tincture field in argent ({colors.on-tincture}) or or. On the sable field, add the argent edge (an inset `rule-strong` ring) so it separates from the night ground.
Do show state by form as well as hue: outline vs. filled shield, the pip plus a word, strike-through for done.
Do divide with one 1px hairline on the 4px scale. Use dashed hairlines only for empty or pending slots.
Do keep controls at 44px (`hit`) with the 2px corner.
Do run motion on `--ease-out` with `--dur-1/2/3` (160, 320, 560ms) so reduced motion sets all of it to zero, including the pennant drop and the banner unfurl.
Do check new colours in both themes. By day the metal is {colors.or-day} and links are {colors.link-day}.
donts: Don't use a tincture as text colour, and don't lay one tincture on another.
Don't use or on anything that isn't an action, focus, or selection, apart from the brand shield and the rule numerals.
Don't set running text, buttons, or labels in IM Fell English SC.
Don't wrap rows or panels in shadowed cards. Lists stay hairline-ruled on flat cloth.
Don't use tracked uppercase labels except as the term attached to a value. Never put one above a heading.
Don't round corners beyond 2px on rectangular surfaces.
